Use this file with one selected slug from [CATALOG.md](../CATALOG.md).

## Brand

Vibrant style

## Style foundations

- Visual style: modern, clean, bold, playful
- Typography scale: 14/16/18/24/32/40 | Fonts: primary=Noto Sans,
  display=Fascinate, mono=Fira Code | weights=100, 200, 300, 400, 500, 600, 700,
  800, 900
- Color palette: primary, secondary, neutral, success | Tokens: primary=#7C61D4,
  secondary=#EAAE87, success=#16A34A, warning=#D97706, danger=#DC2626,
  surface=#FFFFFF, text=#2F281D
- Spacing scale: 2/4/8/12/16/24/32/48

## Copy tone

- Tone: concise, confident, helpful.

## Design intent

Lively, colorful design with bold playful typography, warm accents, and dynamic
visual energy.
